messages:
olivia-sec: Heads-up — CI smoke for audit log coverage just started failing after the RBAC change in eng-platform. Harness reports ~6 regressions across role-related events.

raj-eng: Seen the failures, repro link: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/5483 :eyes: — looks concentrated on role.assign and permission.change events.

audit-bot: Audit-validator: schema mismatch (3 events) — Missing required property 'actor_id' in event types: permission.change, role.assign, role.revoke.

beth-ops: CI snippet: ```AssertionError: event schema error: missing 'actor_id' at tests/smoke/role_assign.json:12
  at tools/audit_validate.py:142```

mike-ci: I can repro locally: `./tools/audit_validate.py tests/smoke --strict` yields same errors. Stack trace points to validator v3 schema.

raj-eng: Root cause is likely our RBAC patch — we introduced system-generated role changes where the producer (Kubernetes rotation job) no longer sets actor_id. It emits `system: true` but no user id.

olivia-sec: Two options: (A) relax schema to make actor_id optional when `system:true`, or (B) ensure event producers populate actor_id for all events. Prefer B for audit integrity, but need a short-term mitigation for CI.

sam-sre: Strong +1 for B. Operators and customers expect actor_id for traceability. Proposal: add ingest-time canonicalizer that fills `actor_id` for system events (e.g. `system:{job_name}`). That preserves strict schema downstream.

raj-eng: I'll open a PR to populate actor_id in the RBAC service for the rotation flow. Short-term I can also add a small shim in the test harness to synthesize actor_id for the harness-only fixtures.

beth-ops: Also seeing a kms-related mismatch in the same run. Validator complaining about `kms.version` type — some fixtures have null now. Example from CI payload: ```"kms": {"cipher": "AES-GCM", "version": null}``` but schema expects number.

mike-ci: I'll add a canonicalizer for KMS payloads too (tools/canonize_kms.py) that normalizes `kms.version` to a string when null, and update the harness. Then run `./tools/audit_validate.py --canonize tests/smoke` in CI.

olivia-sec: Plan and owners: (1) raj-eng — PR to populate actor_id in RBAC emissions (owner). (2) mike-ci — add harness canonicalizers for system actor_id + kms normalization and update CI flags (owner). (3) sam-sre — review ingest-time translation and impact on retention/querying. (4) beth-ops — validate smoke fixtures after changes. ETA: EOD tomorrow for hotfixes, full rollout next week.

raj-eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/eng-platform/pull/987 — includes unit + smoke tests. Tagging @mike-ci for harness sync.

mike-ci: Acknowledged. Will push a harness patch and a CI tweak so failures from existing fixtures are marked as flaky for 48h to reduce alert noise while we land fixes. :clock1:

olivia-sec: Good. If anything spikes in prod telemetry or customers ask, route to #incidents and @oncall. Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread.
